cohort: The study included 125 children aged 2-18 years with Cerebral Palsy (cases) and 125 age-matched controls without CP, recruited from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found that a significant proportion of CP cases (69.6%) resided in rural areas compared to controls (43.2%), OBC representation was higher among cases (64.0%) than controls (34.4%), and 84.8% of CP cases did not cry at birth versus 50.4% of controls.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in delivery mode between CP cases and controls.
